title: Anchor corpus variant prober and severity calibration for cost-tuner rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a robust variant-probing evaluation harness that expands an anchor (golden) corpus into contextual permutations, measures multi-dimensional quality deltas (semantic similarity, hallucination rate, answer-slot fidelity, downstream embedding drift, and latency/cost per response), and produces calibrated severity bands to drive the cost-tuner's automated staged rollout and rollback decisions for batching/caching recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Can generate 10 deterministic and 20 stochastic variants per anchor prompt with reproducible seeding.

Evaluation pipeline computes semantic similarity (embedding cosine), BLEU/ROUGE for structured outputs where applicable, hallucination proxy (fact-check mismatch rate vs. reference), token distribution shift, response length delta, latency delta, and cost-per-response delta for each variant.
Severity calibration maps multi-metric deltas to one of: OK, Minor, Major, Critical using an interpretable scoring function and can be persisted as a decision table.
Integration with rollout orchestrator such that: Minor -> allow canary 5% for 24h, Major -> require human review and restrict to shadow mode, Critical -> auto-block and trigger rollback.
Dashboard visualizations (per-anchor and aggregated) are available in Console with historical baselines and trend lines.
Human-audit sampling UI shows representative variants for any Major or Critical regressions with links to provenance and model config diffs.
Unit and integration tests cover generation, metric computation, and severity mapping with synthetic anchors and golden references.
tasks: Spec: finalize variant taxonomy (prefix/suffix rewrites, paraphrase-preserve-entity, slot-swap, context-truncation, reply-style mutations).
Implement generator library with deterministic/stochastic modes and seed-hash reproducibility.
Metric collectors: embed-client for similarity, hallucination proxy pipeline (search+NLI), token-distribution comparator, latency & cost instrumentation hooks.
Design severity scoring function and decision-table format; provide an override endpoint for manual severity adjustments.
Integrate with rollout service: wire severity -> rollout policy mapping and add webhook for automated hold/rollback signals.
Console: design panels and audit sampling modal; connect to existing observability metrics.
Build CI tests and add synthetic-anchor acceptance tests to nightly regression runs.
Run pilot against two internal workloads (chat-support and summarization) and collect feedback.
current_updates: 2025-09-10: Ticket created after spike showed brittle golden prompts when applying cache-prefetch heuristics on summarization workload.
2025-09-12: Variant taxonomy agreed in sync with PM/Research (Aisha, Marco, Li Wei). Added slot-swap and reply-style mutations to capture UI-level regressions.
2025-09-14: Prototype generator implemented (deterministic paraphrase + masked entity swap). Early runs show embedding-similarity drops concentrated in slot-swap variants.

2025-09-16: Severity mapping workshop held; consensus on multi-metric weighting (0.5 semantic sim, 0.2 hallucination, 0.15 downstream-features, 0.1 latency/cost). Draft decision table checked in to docs.
design_decisions: Use embedding-cosine as primary semantic fidelity signal (open-source embedding model V2) rather than token overlap to be robust to phrasing changes.
Hallucination proxy implemented via search+NLI against indexed canonical docs where available; fallback to heuristic named-entity-check for opaque domains.
Severity bands must be human-interpretable: we prefer thresholds that map to operational actions (canary, human review, block) rather than raw percent deltas.
Generate both deterministic and stochastic variants. Deterministic variants used for baseline regression gates; stochastic variants used for stability/fuzz testing.
Store variant provenance and seed parameters in the result payload to enable replay and manual inspection.
test_plan: Unit tests for variant generator ensuring reproducible outputs for fixed seeds across languages (EN, FR) and typical prompt shapes.
Integration job: inject model change diff into the pipeline and assert severity mapping fires expected action for synthetic critical regression (test harness models included in repo).
Nightly regression: run pilot anchor sets (support, billing, summarization) and record baseline metrics to enable alerting on drift in subsequent runs.
Human review QA: sample 30 Major/30 Minor flagged variants for manual annotation and compute precision/recall of the severity classifier; target >85% precision for Major+Critical.
notes: We must avoid coupling severity thresholds tightly to a single embedding model version; plan to version the similarity baseline and store baseline embeddings alongside anchor records.
For private deployments (VPC/on-prem), provide an offline generator + local evaluation binary; orchestrator will ingest only severity signals, not raw anchors (data minimization).
Consider adding a simple UI knob for ops to relax Minor->Major boundary during high-traffic weekends to reduce noisy rollbacks.
review_feedback: PM (Javier Morales): wants explicit SLAs for human review turnaround when Major is flagged in customer-facing flows.
Research (Li Wei): suggested adding per-customer baseline calibration; we should add a customer-normalization step for large enterprise anchors.
Design (Rina Shah): audit modal needs copy that explains why a variant was flagged and what changed in the model/config to aid reviewer decisions.
